topic: Someone discovers their neighbor is secretly wealthy
text: I've been watching Mr. Thompson from behind the lace curtains of my window, pondering how the flowers in his garden always seem to bloom a little brighter than the rest. It’s no surprise, really, how his old car hardly moves, yet his son drives something shiny and sleek. It’s the little things, like the way the lights in his house stay on a bit too late, suggesting rooms that don’t need to be lit. I wonder how long I’ve known, and why I never mentioned it to anyone. The neighborhood is quieter now, as if everyone is whispering secrets behind closed doors, and I can’t shake the feeling that I’ve been part of it, a spectator in a play I wish I hadn’t seen.
